viirs-snpp.title: VIIRS S-NPP: detections by hour
viirs-snpp.description: One UTC hour per line, oldest first, its detections as columns. An hour's `offset` and `length` in the index are the byte span of its line's JSON object, excluding the newline; one sensor's hours are consecutive, so a span of hours is one `Range: bytes=<first offset>-<last offset+last length-1>` request.
